channel.title: Science Vs
channel.description: There are a lot of fads, blogs and strong opinions, but then there’s SCIENCE. Science Vs is the show from Spotify Studios that finds out what’s fact, what’s not, and what’s somewhere in between. We do the hard work of sifting through all the science so you don't have to and cover everything from 5G and ADHD, to Fluoride and Fasting Diets.
channel.itunes:subtitle: The show that pits facts against everything else, hosted by Wendy Zukerman, from Spotify Studios.
